channel.title: Techmeme (readable links)
channel.description: Top news and commentary for technology's leaders, from all around the web

item.title: Claude flagged 493 security issues across 25 open-source projects, covering 5M+ lines of C, C++, Java, PHP, and Python code; one went unnoticed for 21 years (Chris Rohlf/Anthropic)
item.description:
Chris Rohlf / Anthropic:
Claude flagged 493 security issues across 25 open-source projects, covering 5M+ lines of C, C++, Java, PHP, and Python code; one went unnoticed for 21 years  —  Over the past year, we've published lots of data that shows that frontier AI models are more than capable of discovering and exploiting security vulnerabilities.

Original (direct link): https://www.anthropic.com/research/attack-surface-reduction

item.title: PHP discloses a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed "PHP2Shell", that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August (Robert McMillan/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Robert McMillan / Wall Street Journal:
PHP discloses a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed “PHP2Shell”, that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August  —  AI tools helped find one of the most severe online bugs ever.  Cyber experts are racing to patch it before hackers use AI to exploit it.

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/tech/cybersecurity/ai-just-found-a-bug-that-puts-up-to-70-of-the-worlds-websites-at-risk-fd0902ea?st=tBLRBh&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: PHP releases security fixes for two critical unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities, urging all PHP users to update; all web-serving deployments are affected (PHP)
item.description:
PHP:
PHP releases security fixes for two critical unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities, urging all PHP users to update; all web-serving deployments are affected  —  PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

Original (direct link): https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5

item.title: ServiceNow and Nvidia launch Arc, a personal, long-running enterprise AI agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell (Radhika Rajkumar/ZDNET)
item.description:
Radhika Rajkumar / ZDNET:
ServiceNow and Nvidia launch Arc, a personal, long-running enterprise AI agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell  —  The two companies are trying to solve the AI agent security conundrum with multiple layers of real-time security checks.

Original (direct link): https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/exclusive-servicenow-and-nvidia-launch-arc-a-new-ai-agent-for-enterprise/

item.title: Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March (Rosie Harris-Davison/City A.M.)
item.description:
Rosie Harris-Davison / City A.M.:
Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March  —  Legal tech firm Legora has raised $550m (£410m) in Series E funding as it expands its footprint in the US, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Original (direct link): https://www.cityam.com/legora-raises-550-in-funding-to-lead-global-expansion/

item.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August (Alix Coutures/The Information)
item.description:
Alix Coutures / The Information:
OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August  —  OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT ads to 26 more countries as it tries to turn advertising into a bigger source of revenue to help cover its AI costs.

Original (direct link): https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-expands-chatgpt-ads-26-countries-says-100-000-advertisers

item.title: Apple says it plans to add Reachability for the iPhone Duo later in 2026, helping people with smaller hands more easily access the left or right display edges (Julian Chokkattu/Wired)
item.description:
Julian Chokkattu / Wired:
Apple says it plans to add Reachability for the iPhone Duo later in 2026, helping people with smaller hands more easily access the left or right display edges  —  Apple made an astonishingly good first foldable.  Now iOS and third-party apps need time to catch up.  —  Rating:

Original (direct link): https://www.wired.com/review/apple-iphone-duo/

item.title: Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
item.description:
Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge:
Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify  —  Say goodbye to those aux cables.  Spotify's new in-car app is here, and it's rolling out to Audi vehicles today.

Original (direct link): https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1014261/spotify-native-car-app-audi-android-automotive-carplay

item.title: Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others (Thomas Claburn/The Register)
item.description:
Thomas Claburn / The Register:
Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others  —  Nvidia has proposed a new way to keep corporate AI agents in line.  —  Nvidia on Wednesday introduced its OpenShell Reference Architecture.

Original (direct link): https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/10/21/nvidia-picks-openshell-to-tame-ai-gents/5304319

item.title: GTC Berlin: Jensen Huang pushes Europe on AI adoption, saying "for Europe to benefit from AI ... you need all the end markets, the end industries to adopt AI" (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
GTC Berlin: Jensen Huang pushes Europe on AI adoption, saying “for Europe to benefit from AI ... you need all the end markets, the end industries to adopt AI”  —  Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang pushed Europe to adopt artificial intelligence more quickly …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/nvidia-ceo-huang-pitches-europe-on-all-industries-adopting-ai

item.title: OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
item.description:
Jordan Novet / CNBC:
OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April  —  OpenAI will make its artificial intelligence models available for developers through Google's cloud, following years of competition between the two companies.

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/openai-bring-its-ai-models-to-googles-cloud-expands-beyond-microsoft.html

item.title: iPhone Duo review: fun to play with and cool matte inner display, but small cover display, heavier and bulkier than other phones, average cameras, and gets hot (The Verge)
item.description:
The Verge:
iPhone Duo review: fun to play with and cool matte inner display, but small cover display, heavier and bulkier than other phones, average cameras, and gets hot  —  The iPhone Duo is the riskiest Apple product in years.  It's a huge rethink of what an iPhone is and could be …

Original (direct link): https://www.theverge.com/tech/1015028/iphone-duo-review

item.title: Memo: eBay is cutting ~9% of its workforce to simplify operations and reallocate resources toward high-growth areas; eBay cut 6%, or ~800 staff, in February (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:
Memo: eBay is cutting ~9% of its workforce to simplify operations and reallocate resources toward high-growth areas; eBay cut 6%, or ~800 staff, in February  —  EBay (EBAY.O) will lay off about 9% of its workforce as the online marketplace looks to simplify operations and shift resources …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/business/world-at-work/ebay-lay-off-9-workforce-push-simplify-operations-internal-memo-shows-2026-10-21/

item.title: The EU Commission launches a DSA probe into Booking Holdings' Booking.com to determine whether it is doing enough to combat fraudulent listings and phishing (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
item.description:
Foo Yun Chee / Reuters:
The EU Commission launches a DSA probe into Booking Holdings' Booking.com to determine whether it is doing enough to combat fraudulent listings and phishing  —  EU tech regulators will investigate whether online hotel reservation website Booking.com is doing enough to weed out fraudulent listings …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/bookingcom-targeted-eu-investigation-into-phishing-scams-fraudulent-listings-2026-10-21/

item.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith raised a $66M Series C led by Sequoia Capital at a $1B valuation, up from $550M after raising a $45M Series B in August (Beatrice Nolan/Fortune)
item.description:
Beatrice Nolan / Fortune:
AI code-testing startup Blacksmith raised a $66M Series C led by Sequoia Capital at a $1B valuation, up from $550M after raising a $45M Series B in August  —  Blacksmith, a startup that runs the infrastructure companies use to test code before it ships, has been valued at $1 billion following …

Original (direct link): https://fortune.com/2026/10/21/exclusive-ai-code-testing-startup-blacksmith-hits-1-billion-valuation-as-ai-written-code-surges/
